summary: This round adds two small changes. Demo actions now return their sample result before the usage budget is consumed, so demo visitors cannot use up the shared action limit. `publishTemplate` refuses names that start with `demo-`, which keeps template names, installed-copy links and demo paths apart. Both are tested: the `app_usage` table has no action rows after a demo action, and the `demo-reading` template name is refused. All temp tests pass, every changed line is covered or validly exempt, and no findings remain.
